title: The volcano that cooled the whole planet 🌋
subject: volcano
description:
Could one eruption do this again? 👇

The 1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo in the Philippines was the second-largest of the 20th century. Its sulfur dioxide haze spread around the world and lowered Earth's average temperature by about 1°F (0.6°C).

Sources: NASA Earth Observatory ("Global Effects of Mount Pinatubo"), Wikipedia (1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo)
tags: can a volcano cool the planet

scenes.text: One volcano made the entire planet colder.
On June 15, 1991, Mount Pinatubo in the Philippines blasted ash 40 kilometers into the sky.
It was the second-largest eruption of the 20th century.
Wet, heavy ash piled onto roofs until they caved in. 847 people died.
The blast pushed about 15 million tons of sulfur dioxide into the stratosphere.
Winds spread the haze around the globe. Within 15 months, scientists measured the whole planet about 1 degree Fahrenheit cooler.
